setting.Dockerpath.description: Docker (or Podman or WSLc) executable name or path.
setting.Dockercomposepath.description: Docker Compose executable name or path.
setting.ServerDownloadBaseUrl.descriptio: Base URL for downloading the VS Code server. The path `/commit:{commit}/server-{platform}/{quality}` will be appended to this URL. Platforms include `linux-x64`, `linux-armhf`, `linux-arm64`, `linux-alpine`, and `alpine-arm64`. Quality is `stable` or `insider`.
setting.ServerDownloadBaseUrl.patternErr: Must be a URL (e.g., https://example.com or https://example.com:8080/path).
setting.ServerDownloadFolder.description: Local folder for downloading and caching VS Code server archives. The archives will be stored as `{downloadFolder}/{commit}/vscode-server-{platform}[-{quality}].tar.gz`. Platforms include `linux-x64`, `linux-armhf`, `linux-arm64`, `linux-alpine`, and `alpine-arm64`. Quality is `stable` or `insider`. The `-{quality}` suffix is omitted for `stable`. The default is in the system's temp folder.
setting.CacheVolume.description: Controls whether a Docker volume should be used to cache the VS Code server and extensions.
setting.Defaultextensions.description: Configures the list of extensions to always install while creating a container.
setting.WorkspaceMountConsistency.descri: The consistency level used for the workspace mount (existing containers must be rebuilt to take effect).
setting.MountGitWorktreeCommonDir.descri: Mount the Git worktree common dir for Git operations to work in the container. This requires the worktree to be created with relative paths (`git worktree add --relative-paths`).

setting.DefaultFeatures.description: Configures the list of features to always install while creating a container.
setting.Lockfile.description: Controls whether a devcontainer-lock.json should be written.
setting.RepositoryConfigurationPaths.des: Absolute paths of folders that hold dev container configurations for repositories. A configuration for a repository goes in <folder>/<host>/<path of the repository>/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json, with the host and the path as the repository's remote URL gives them. Only literal absolute paths are read: no ~ and no variables.
setting.DockerSocketPath.description: Docker socket path. Used, e.g., when connecting to a Dev Container with the devcontainer.json in a Docker Volume.
setting.BootstrapImage.description: Docker image to use as the bootstrap container for cloning repositories into Docker volumes, and for inspect and recovery containers. When set, this image is used directly instead of building from the built-in Dockerfile. The image must include the Docker and Git CLIs, and optionally SSH, Git LFS and Node.js. When Node.js is not installed, it will be added from a VS Code Server download matching the architecture.
setting.BootstrapImagePull.description: Automatically pull the bootstrap image before starting the bootstrap container. Only applies when a custom bootstrap image is configured.
